purpose: The Support Console API allows support agents to manage customer data, issue goodwill credits, reverse fees, and export customer data.

components.name: console-backend
components.evidence: console-backend validates the token of the agent with Keycloak

components.name: console-db
components.evidence: console-db (PostgreSQL) has two groups of tables: customer_profile (copy of the profile, refreshed every night) and agent_action (append only).

flows.data: customer profiles and agent action records
flows.evidence: console-backend reads and writes console-db (PostgreSQL) with the customer profiles and the agent action records.
